instruction: Download the lecture slide PDFs for weeks 1-5 from the CS50 Python course into the lecture_slides folder.

metadata.explanation: Verifies existence of lecture PDFs for weeks 1-5 (5 files: lecture1.pdf through lecture5.pdf). Partial credit: 0.2 per file found.
metadata.verification: Evaluated by checking file existence and count in /home/user/lecture_slides/ directory via bash ls command.

Metric logic correctly checks for presence of required files with appropriate partial credit (0.2 per file)
